summary: Subtlety with Hemorrhage, Ghostly Strike, Premeditation and Preparation, plus Seal Fate in Assassination, on the synthetic daggers. It is the Subtlety preset; the defining talents are pinned.
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate; Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less
3-point Rupture when not ticking, with Hemorrhage right before it
Premeditation at 3 combo points or fewer (no Stealth needed)
Vanish into Ambush at 3 combo points or fewer, pooling energy; Preparation resets Vanish and Premeditation
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 31 Agility and 15 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Fight never opens from Stealth; Stealth only comes from Vanish
Ghostly Strike is worth nothing over Hemorrhage (+0.5 removed) but is pinned by the build
Premeditation out of Stealth and Preparation's reset list are open for beta testing
Elusiveness is worth 0 at 180 s, -2.9 at 300 s
Murder is damage only (+4% vs Humanoids and Giants) and does nothing on the generic boss, so its 2 points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers); the vs Humanoid build keeps Murder 2/2
Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV) left out under Forever; would add +13 to +18
Grimstitch 4/5-piece bonuses not live on the synthetic gear (about +8 / +6 for Combat Daggers)
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir omitted for consistency (+8 via Dragonbreath Chili)
notes: Only Subtlety build, so treated as the Subtlety default.
